justification: The 13-vertex graph is distinct from the 12-vertex Chvátal reference. Its four generators give degree 4, and no three generators sum to 0 modulo 13, so it is triangle-free. An independent 5-set would have cyclic gaps {2,2,2,3,4} or {2,2,3,3,3}; either arrangement forces adjacent gaps 2 and 3, creating an edge of difference 5. Thus every independent set has size at most 4, making a 3-coloring of 13 vertices impossible.
